description: The dependency rules every repo of TJ's shares (zimmertr/yggdrasil record 0056). A repo extends this file and adds only its own rules.
Every release waits seven days before it is proposed, so a compromised one has a week to be noticed and pulled. Security updates skip the wait.
A registry that gives no publish date (GHCR, Quay, ECR) can't be aged, so its updates don't wait: timestamp-optional. The default would hold them forever.

packageRules.description: Everything below a major merges itself once the repo's required checks pass. A major waits for TJ.
yggdrasil's own modules don't wait: they are TJ's releases, so there is no stranger's release to watch for a week.

A Terraform provider is pinned twice: a range in the .tf files and an exact version in .terraform.lock.hcl. update-lockfile moves the lock file when a release fits the range. Without it Renovate proposes only a release outside the range.
Python numbers its yearly, breaking releases as minors (3.14 to 3.15), so a Python minor waits for TJ like a major. A patch (3.14.1 to 3.14.2) still merges itself.

helm-unittest's image tags join the Helm version and the plugin's, as 4.3.0-1.2.1. Docker versioning takes the part after the hyphen as a fixed suffix and would never offer the plugin's updates. Here the plugin's major is the major, so a new one waits for TJ like any major, then Helm's minor and patch and the plugin's minor and patch are compared in turn. Helm's major is the compatibility: a Helm 5 tag comes with the Helm 5 move in setup-helm, not on its own (record 0060).

customManagers.description: Docker images a Makefile pins for its targets, as `NAME := image:tag@sha256:...`. Renovate has no Makefile manager, so without this they would only move by hand (record 0060). Only a pin with its digest is read, so a bare tag is a reminder to add one.
